task:
Implement the real Phase 12 Android companion and its required authenticated desktop transport on a new local branch feat/phase-12-android-companion starting exactly from remote main SHA d0021802288136ffe4da1f3b91356722b015270f. If the checkout is still on the previous Phase 11 branch, switch/create the local branch from that exact SHA before editing; do not change remote refs. Read the repository AGENTS.md and required AIP implementation, phase, security, and publication skills, the attached roadmap section Phase 12 (real Android client + APK), docs/PHASE_12_ANDROID_SPEC.md, docs/PHASE_13_GATEWAY_SPEC.md, existing companion.rs/gateway.rs, migrations 0019/0020/0024, contracts, UI, and CI first.

The deliverable must be functional, not metadata-only. Create a maintained native Android project under android/ (Kotlin, pinned Gradle wrapper/AGP/Kotlin/SDK versions, package ID, reproducible debug build, unit tests, lint, and a real debug APK). Use a dependency-light native View stack where practical. Add Portuguese product UI with text conversation, an in-app floating icon and an optional overlay service that is never enabled/requested without an explicit user action and Android overlay permission/policy, bounded notifications with no sensitive message text by default, read-only offline history, a bounded offline outgoing-text queue, reconnect/compatibility status, and explicit approval for queued actions. Persist only bounded metadata/text needed for these features; never persist media bytes, raw credentials, screenshots, or desktop Python/runtime data. Hash the APK and document the artifact path/hash.

Implement Android credential custody with Android Keystore (AES-GCM or equivalent), no plaintext pairing secret in SharedPreferences/files/logs. Implement secure pairing UX that displays and confirms the exact desktop fingerprint/one-time pairing metadata. Add protocol/client code for versioned `aip-companion-v1` frames with strict size limits, version negotiation, nonce and monotonically increasing replay counter, authenticated challenge-response (HMAC-SHA-256 or equivalent standard construction), timeout/reconnect behavior, typed failures, and key rotation/revocation handling. Keep the Android client usable in standalone/offline mode when no desktop transport is available.

Implement the actual desktop companion transport required by Android, preserving Rust/SQLite authority and existing fixture commands. It must be explicit Owner-enabled, disabled by default, bind loopback/private only (never public/broad by default), use a versioned length/newline-delimited bounded JSON protocol, reject malformed/oversized frames and unsupported versions, authenticate every session/message, enforce nonce/replay/idempotency/ownership/agent/safe-mode/temporary-chat/quota gates, and close cleanly on stop/revoke/rotation. Pairing credentials should be ephemeral or OS-protected on desktop; do not write raw secrets to SQLite, audits, logs, or docs. Expose bounded Tauri commands/UI for start/stop/status and one-time pairing metadata. Support deterministic loopback/emulator integration with the Android client for handshake, history, queue preview/approval/cancel, reconnect, replay rejection, revocation, and safe standalone fallback. Do not create an AIP-hosted relay, public listener, Cloudflare service, or Python-runtime exposure. Keep Phase 13 BielOS integration metadata-only for this scoped branch, but make the transport versioned so Phase 13 can harden/extend it.

Add focused Rust/TypeScript/Android tests for bounds, protocol negotiation, HMAC/auth failure, replay/nonce/idempotency, pairing ownership and expiry, key rotation/revocation, loopback request/response, queue/history limits, cancellation/stop, safe-mode and temporary-chat denial, Android Keystore/queue behavior, notification/privacy behavior, and offline reconnect. Update migrations with the minimum new transport/key metadata schema, preserving fixture migrations and no raw secret storage. Update contracts, Portuguese UI, docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md, docs/CORRECTIVE_GAP_MATRIX.md, README.md, and add a truthful docs/PHASE_12_ANDROID_IMPLEMENTATION.md describing functional automated/emulator boundaries and remaining physical-device/manual checks. Extend CI with a reproducible Android build/test/lint job and APK artifact upload if the repository workflow can support it; keep existing desktop gates intact.

Before commit run and report: cargo fmt --check; cargo check --locked; cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --locked --lib plus focused companion/transport tests; contracts typecheck/build/tests; desktop typecheck/tests/build; Android unit tests, lint, and assembleDebug; protocol/integration loopback or emulator validation where available; APK SHA-256; pnpm secrets:scan; git diff --check; clean-tree verification. If Android SDK/JDK/Gradle are missing, normal user-space installation/download is authorized; do not silently skip the APK. If a toolchain download or physical device is genuinely unavailable, report the exact blocker and still leave the buildable project and all possible tests. Commit only this Phase 12 scope with exact message `feat: implement phase 12 android companion`. Do not push, publish, create PR, merge, tag, release, or deploy.

Do not weaken existing Owner, safe-mode, privacy, standalone, resource, or audit controls; do not modify BielOS. Use only the configured Biel4 App Server Executor in fast mode; no native subagents and no direct manual code edits outside the Executor.
constraints: Use only the configured Biel4 App Server Executor in fast mode; no native subagents and no alternate backend.
Local edits and one scoped local commit are authorized; no remote GitHub mutation, push, PR, merge, tag, release, or deployment.
Phase 12 must produce a real buildable Android project and debug APK, not metadata, mocks, or a non-building description.
Transport is explicit, authenticated, bounded, local/private-only by default, and fail-closed; no relay, public listener, telemetry, raw secret, raw media, or Python runtime exposure.
Preserve existing fixture-only companion/gateway paths and all Rust/SQLite Owner/agent/safe-mode/temporary-chat/idempotency/audit gates.
Do not import BielOS code or implement Phase 13 external integration in this request.
